content.text: When a board is filtered (e.g. assignee=me and status=in_progress in the query string), using Open in new tab on a card preserves only /cards/{id} and drops the filter query string from the opener URL context. That is expected for the card URL, but the parent board tab also rewrites its history to strip filter params when the context menu open fires.
Opening a card in a new tab should not mutate the source board filter URL. The board route listens to a global card:open event and calls setSearchParams with only card, wiping other params.
People lose multi-filter setups after middle-clicking a card and have to re-apply filters. Scope the param write to the new tab navigation target only, not the opener history.
